scraped.scraped_description: I originally created this framework with an information security point of view.  Since then, the response from other fields and disciplines has been incredible.  I would love to be able to include any other OSINT resources, especially from fields outside of infosec.  Please let me know about anything that might be missing!

name: OSINT Framework
tagline: A curated collection of free OSINT tools and resources for information gathering
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Relies on third-party OSINT tools and resources; dependent on continued maintenance of linked tools; potential for link rot as external resources become unavailable

academic_citations.title: Key Challenges and Limitations of the OSINT Framework in the Context of Cybersecurity
From Theory to Practice: Towards an OSINT Framework to Mitigate Arabic Social Cyber Attacks

documented_limitations: No formal documentation of limitations; resource curation is manual and may have gaps; some linked tools may become outdated or deprecated
failure_modes: Link rot from external resources; potential for included tools to be taken offline; no automated verification of tool functionality
curation_criteria: Free OSINT resources and tools, with some sites offering paid features
contributor_governance: Solo maintainer; community contributions accepted via GitHub pull requests
political_relevance_summary: OSINT Framework addresses threats to digital rights and online privacy, providing infrastructure that protects civic freedoms in an increasingly surveilled digital environment.

movement_building_utility.notes: OSINT Framework primarily serves as an information resource for researchers, journalists, or analysts working on civic and political issues.

generalizability_notes: High generalizability. OSINT Framework is open source and already deployed across multiple countries/jurisdictions, making replication straightforward for other contexts.
